reviews.text: Alright so I picked this up on a whim, played it for like few (not counting demo plays) hours straight and here I am writing a review at midnight so make of that what you will. It's a wave survival roguelite — bugs, top-down, you level up and pick upgrades. Nothing you haven't heard before. But the build system here actually has teeth. There's this synergy mechanic where if you push a weapon or ability far enough it transforms into something way stronger, and chasing that in every run becomes kind of addicting. Some runs you never get there. Some runs everything lines up and you feel unstoppable. That gap is what keeps you coming back. Story is locked behind difficulty clears which I actually respect. You don't just get handed it — you earn it. Chaos mode is pure chaos in a good way, curse cards keep stacking and at some point you're just barely surviving and loving every second of it. It's Early Access so yeah, content is still coming — only a few story chapters in right now and I definitely wanted more by the end. More maps would be welcome too. But honestly for the price? I've paid way more for games I dropped after an hour. This one I had to force myself to stop playing. If you like this genre even a little, just grab it. Gameplay ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Build depth ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Content (EA) ⭐⭐⭐ 4/5 Replayability ⭐⭐⭐⭐ 4/5 Value for money ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ 5/5 Overall: 8.5 / 10

当steam商店里琳琅满目的游戏让人挑花眼时，一款售价比较亲民的塔防割草肉鸽游戏《bug alliance》悄然登场，在末日题材的红海中掀起了一阵独特的虫群风暴。游戏的背景设定在森林枯竭、文明崩塌的末日地球，人类试图在绝境中寻找生机。这一设定本身就充满了张力，让玩家在进入游戏前就被深深吸引。 而当真正踏入游戏，俯视角的战斗视角带来的沉浸感更是直接拉满。每一局都是全新的开始，程序生成的关卡意味着你永远不知道下一个转角会遇到什么，能获得资源丰厚的报酬，还是铺天盖地的敌潮，这种未知感让每一次出击都充满了刺激。同时玩家的每一次升级选择都关乎生死，不同升级方向会构筑出截然不同的战斗风格...每一次取舍都会显著改变后续战局走向，这种“蝴蝶效应”让游戏的策略性大大增强，玩家需要在瞬息万变的战场上做出最适合当下的判断。 不过，游戏也并非完美无瑕。由于是小成本制作，游戏的画面细节还有提升空间，部分敌人的攻击模式略显单一，长时间游玩可能会让人感到些许重复。但考虑到其低廉的价格，这些小瑕疵完全可以接受。如果你是塔防割草肉鸽游戏的爱好者，或者对末日题材情有独钟，那么这款游戏是值得你入手一试的。

Тактическая стратегия с армией насекомых: управляйте жуками, развивайте колонию и сражайтесь за территорию. Необычная тематика, командные бои и прокачка делают игру свежей и увлекательной.
A top-down action roguelite where you lead mutated insect warriors against the remnants of a cruel humanity. Survive 20-wave maps, defeat climactic bosses, and uncover a 13-chapter story campaign.
An addictive roguelite with fresh builds every run! Boss fights are intense, story mode is engaging, and Chaos Surge offers endless challenges. Perfect for fans of action and strategy!
Top-down roguelite with 13 story chapters unlocked via difficulty. 20-wave maps, synergies, and Chaos Surge endless mode. Very deep.
